title: dep-scan mcp run_scan output
description: The document the run_scan tool of `depscan mcp` returns. The default is a dry run: the depscan scan command the tool would run, as its argument vector, and the effective scan options in the form `depscan config show --format json` writes them, with nothing executed. A real run, which needs the server to have been started with --allow-scans and execute: true, returns the scan entry the scans document carries for the target, scanned or refused exactly as that document's schema defines it. The two shapes are never mixed.

argv.description: The depscan scan command the real run would execute, as its argument vector, starting with the program name.

options.description: The effective options the scan would receive, in the form `depscan config show --format json` writes: one entry per option with its value and the source that set it.
